_comment: Non-sensitive automation steps. No credentials here — those live in credentials.local.json. Replace the example below with your actual billing-system flow.
name: Example: submit a billing entry

loginStep.usernameField: Username field label or selector, e.g. '#login-username'
loginStep.passwordField: Password field label or selector, e.g. '#login-password'

steps.target: URL to go to after login, e.g. the billing entry form page

steps.value: What to type, or {{variable}} if it changes each run

steps.target: Text or element that confirms success, e.g. 'Entry saved'
